rationale:
Idea:
The SpikingFLABlock_Comba_v3 architecture is an evolution of the previous versions, driven by the core objective to further enhance the

callouts.1: Explicit spike encoders: standalone neurons spike the normed input of both sub-layers, the o-norm output and fc1's output (replacing GELU), so every weight sees binary spikes.
callouts.2: Conv output spike taps: a neuron fires on each ShortConv output, but the core still receives the analog conv output; the taps only add to the collected spike count.
callouts.3: Tanh-free spiking feedback: the decay feedback is SpikingLinear(1→8) → LIF → SpikingLinear(8→1) with no tanh and no ±2 bound, so the state-norm feedback can shift the decay logit without limit; its spikes are collected.

enc.label: LIF
enc.tip: standalone spiking neuron: the normed input enters the token mixer as binary spikes

cq.label: ShortConv
cq.tip: SpikingConvWrapper: a neuron spikes the conv OUTPUT, but the analog output is what feeds the core; the spikes are only logged
